title: Jamia Masjid Thal
subtitle: Wooden mosque on the Panjkora bank, Thal village, Kumrat

landmark.name: Jamia Masjid Thal
edits: The mosque is the Atlas TRELLIS model made from one CC BY-SA Commons photo (Asfandyarlahor, Thall_Mosque_Dir_Kumrat.jpg); it is not a survey.
The model's size, 25 x 23 x 24 m, is estimated from that photo, not measured; OSM maps no footprint for the mosque.
The ground within 30 m of the mosque is levelled to its base; the rest of the village is the DEM slope, and its houses are not mapped in OSM so they are not drawn.

sources.name: Jamia Masjid Thal model (TRELLIS, MIT; photo CC BY-SA 4.0)
sources.use: the mosque, generated from one Commons photo by Asfandyarlahor
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (photo, share-alike applies to the derived model); TRELLIS code MIT

road: Dir to Thal paved road (OSM ref S-16)
osm_use: the S-16 road from the south-west to the bridge at the mosque; the Panjkora river; no building footprints mapped in Thal
